item.title: What The Rare Total Eclipse In 2026 Has In Store For Your Sign
item.description: A rare celestial event is on the horizon this year: August will bring the first total solar eclipse for mainland Europe since 1999, passing over the Arctic Ocean, Greenland, Iceland, the Atlantic Ocean, Portugal and northern Spain. Astrologer Lisa Stardust breaks down what the eclipse has in store for your star sign.
